patch_description: The prior best scorer (0.82) used Powell on softmax-parametrized smooth soft-min with mirror-symmetric starts; the current program's L-BFGS-B with numeric gradients underperforms (0.69). Best strategy: hybrid — keep the active-set soft-min idea and simplex feasibility, but use Powell (derivative-free, well-suited to this nonsmooth-ish objective), reduce per-temperature iterations, and expand the start pool to 15 with more mirror-paired starts (symmetry exploitation credited in every top scorer). Also add a final low-temperature polish on the best solution only, spending budget where it matters.
